definitions.gloss: fruit peel; fruit skin; rind; pericarp
definitions.explanation: The outer covering of a fruit, including the skin and any layers between the skin and the seeds. A botanical and culinary term.

examples.japanese: レモンの{果皮|かひ}をすりおろす。
この{果物|くだもの}は{果皮|かひ}ごと{食|た}べられる。
examples.english: You can eat this fruit together with the peel.

examples.japanese: {柑橘類|かんきつるい}の{果皮|かひ}には{栄養|えいよう}が{豊富|ほうふ}に{含|ふく}まれている。
examples.english: The peel of citrus fruits is rich in nutrients.

notes:
Composed of {果|か} (fruit) + {皮|ひ} (skin, peel). A formal term used in botany, food science, and product labeling. In everyday conversation, {皮|かわ} alone is more commonly used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {果皮|かひ}をむく — to peel the fruit skin
- {果皮|かひ}ごと{食|た}べる — to eat with the peel
- {乾燥|かんそう}{果皮|かひ} — dried fruit peel

RELATED WORDS:
- {果肉|かにく} — fruit flesh, pulp
- {果汁|かじゅう} — fruit juice
- {皮|かわ} — skin, peel (everyday term)
- {外皮|がいひ} — outer skin (more general term)
